products.name: MEXICAN CHIAPAS
products.notes: Dark chocolate · Brown sugar · Roasted nuts
products.scene: Dramatic coffee splash frozen behind the bag, scattered beans and a black branded mug in foreground; terracotta textured background and warm sunlight.

products.name: LEGENDER BRAZIL
products.scene: Low diagonal hero bag and black branded mug, sculptural swoosh of flowing coffee behind both, walnut and green textured studio environment.

scripts.short: Love a bold cup? Meet Mexican Chiapas. Dark chocolate, brown sugar, roasted nuts, and a smoky finish. Dark roasted, full-bodied, and ready for your Bean Bros ritual.
scripts.long: Here is what sets this coffee apart. Chiapas is a highland growing region in southern Mexico. Our Mexican Chiapas is dark roasted for a full-bodied cup with deep sweetness. Those chocolate and nut descriptions are tasting notes, not a recipe. Start by tasting your coffee black, then try your usual splash of milk. Discover Mexican Chiapas from Bean Bros.

scripts.short: Chocolate and nut lovers, this is your coffee. Legender Brazil brings milk chocolate, caramel, hazelnut, and brown sugar notes together in one smooth cup. Find your favorite at Bean Bros.
scripts.long: Legender comes from Brazil's Minas Gerais coffee region. This coffee is naturally processed, meaning the coffee fruit dries around the seed before it is removed. Our cup profile brings milk chocolate, caramel, hazelnut, and brown sugar notes. Tasting notes describe what the coffee reminds you of. Try it black first, then add milk to explore the difference. Meet Legender Brazil.
